Story: As a treasury clerk, I want to register a taxpayer with a mobile number, so that I can bill them later.
AC-1 Register a taxpayer · AC-2 Spaces around the name are removed · AC-3 A wrong mobile is refused · AC-4 A wrong name is refused (100 letters OK, 101 not) · AC-5 The same mobile cannot be registered twice · AC-6 Only I can see my taxpayer
Training setup › 1 — Create a taxpayer
Upon page load

W1 · Core + · the form opens empty
Steps: Home › Create my data
→ On screen: heading "1 — Create a taxpayer"; empty boxes Full name, Mobile (09XXXXXXXXX), Email (optional); button "Create taxpayer"
Element validations

W2 · Syntax − · mobile with 10 digits, on the screen
Steps: Full name "Ana Dela Cruz", Mobile "0917123456" › Create taxpayer
→ On screen: under Mobile: "must be a PH mobile 09XXXXXXXXX or +639XXXXXXXXX"; no result box
Email rules (Card 02)
Functional validations

W3 · Users + · create a taxpayer, on the screen
Steps: Full name "  Ana Dela Cruz  ", Mobile <new mobile> › Create taxpayer
→ On screen: "Ana Dela Cruz created — mobile <new mobile>."
My data › My taxpayers

W4 · Core + · my taxpayer is in the list
Steps: create a taxpayer › top bar › My data
→ On screen: row Ana Dela Cruz | <new mobile> | —
Manual: is the form clear for a clerk?
Risk: a wrong mobile means the taxpayer can't be found on the portal; a duplicate mobile splits one person's bills
Coverage: name and mobile rules, duplicate mobile, read-back, privacy; leaves out email (Card 02)
